correctness.rationale: The exact Poissonized last-arrival formula is derived and the j=2 four-type coefficients integrate to the closed middle-tail rational function. The polynomial P equals the positive-denominator multiple of 47/144 - T(p). Exact integer expansion and separately stored complete 955-term coefficient table with all coefficients positive prove T(p) <= 47/144, strictly if any ordered gap is positive. Long Theorem 2.2 proves the lower endpoint mass order and AM-GM proves the final tail. A standard-library checker rederives the polynomial and reproduces 1942 assertions; finite tests are not substituted for the proof.

value.rationale: The motivating source explicitly identifies ordinary stochastic order as a desired strengthening and notes that transform orders do not yield it. Four types is the first case requiring a genuinely interior upper tail beyond a left-PGF endpoint and the maximum-product endpoint, making this a natural smallest open instance. The exact sharp 47/144 bound and all-parameter positivity certificate settle the complete four-type second-sibling first-order comparison and offer a tractable benchmark for the remaining N and higher-sibling problem.
